## MODEL-BY-MODEL FINDINGS

### MODEL 1: NOTION / DIGITAL TEMPLATES (Gumroad, Etsy, Payhip)

**Precedents (verified):**
- Thomas Frank: $1M revenue by 2022, two templates, ~$15K/month at peak [SOURCE: automateed.com, kupkaike.com]
- Easlo ("Notion Guy"): $500K+ total, $20K/month by October 2022 [SOURCE: kupkaike.com]
- Nick Lafferty: $80K in 12 months [SOURCE: sendowl.com]
- Honest floor case: creator with 7,068 views/609 sales earned $304 total in 2025 — $25/month [SOURCE: lowcontentprofits.com]

**Mechanical cash flow:**
- Buyer pays $5–$75 one-time per template (bundles $17-$47)
- Platform fee: Gumroad 10%, Etsy 6.5% + $0.20 listing, Payhip 0-5%
- No inventory, no fulfillment. Buyer downloads instantly.

**Sleep test (30 days zero work):**
PARTIAL. Revenue continues on existing listings. But: Etsy algorithm deprioritizes inactive shops. Gumroad requires self-driven traffic. Without ongoing promotion or SEO, sales decay to near-zero within 60-90 days for most sellers.

**Capital to start:** $0 (Gumroad free tier), ~$30 for Etsy first 20 listings

**P10/P50/P90 income estimates (monthly, after 12 months):**
- P10: $25-$50/month (no audience, no SEO, low volume catalog)
- P50: $300-$1,800/month (10-30 template catalog, some social presence)
- P90: $3,000-$10,000/month (viral template, niche authority, 50+ catalog)
- [SOURCE: kupkaike.com, automateed.com, sendowl.com — triangulated across 3 sources]

**Base rate — who actually earns >$1K/month:**
No hard survey data isolated to template sellers. Proxying from digital product creator cohorts: estimated 10-15% of active sellers reach $1K/month consistently. The majority earn under $300/month. The $500K success stories represent the top 1-2%.

**AI disruption risk: HIGH for generic templates, MEDIUM for niche/system templates**
- Canva's AI Magic Design, Gamma, Notion AI all generate basic templates for free
- Generic resume/social media templates: already commoditized by AI
- Complex operational systems (CRM, project tracker, SOPs): still require human design thinking
- Timeline: generic template category already degrading 2024-2025; niche operational templates have 2-3 year window

**Competition level 2025-2026:** Saturated at generic level. Etsy has 10M+ digital listings. Survivable only in specific sub-niches (industry-specific workflows, language-specific templates).

**Lindy score:** Template selling as a model = 25+ years (existed since desktop publishing). Digital download version = 10+ years.

**Precedents (verified):**

- Customer pays $19-$149/month subscription (or annual)
- Stripe takes 2.9% + $0.30/transaction
- Hosting: $5-$50/month (Railway, Fly.io, Render)
- Revenue is recurring — the compound flywheel is real

**Sleep test (30 days zero work):**
MOSTLY YES for months 1-18 if churn is below 5%/month. Reality: average SaaS churn is 5-7%/month for small products, meaning you lose 60-85% of customers annually without active retention. True passive = only if churn <2% and no competitor eats your niche.

**Capital to start:** $0-$200 (domain + first month hosting). No-code tools (Bubble, Glide, Softr) bring dev cost to near zero.

**P10/P50/P90 income estimates (monthly, at 18 months):**
- P10: $0 (never found product-market fit, abandoned — this is the modal outcome)
- P50: $500-$2,000/month (reached paying users but plateaued)
- P90: $5,000-$20,000/month (found niche PMF, recurring)
- Median profitable micro-SaaS: $4,200 MRR [SOURCE: freemius.com, MicroConf data]

**Base rate — who actually earns >$1K/month:**
70% of micro-SaaS founders never break $1,000 MRR [SOURCE: freemius.com/MicroConf triangulated]. Only 18% reach the $1K-$5K sustainability zone. Median time to $1K MRR: 12-18 months.

**AI disruption risk: VARIABLE — HIGH for single-feature tools, LOW for workflow-integrated tools**
- AI-powered competitors can replicate single-feature SaaS in weeks (2025 reality)
- Workflow-integrated tools with data lock-in survive longer
- The "AI feature replication" failure mode is now the #1 new killer [SOURCE: freemius.com]

**Competition level 2025-2026:** Extremely high at surface level. Wide open in micro-niches serving specific industries (not "productivity" broadly).

**Lindy score:** SaaS as model = 25+ years. Micro-SaaS = 10+ years. Model structurally durable.

- Shopify: keep 100% of first $1M revenue from Jan 2025; 85% above that [SOURCE: shopify.dev]
- Subscription model ($19-$99/month) > one-time license (support costs eat one-time revenue)

**Sleep test (30 days zero work):**
NO for WordPress/Shopify plugins. WordPress core updates break plugins regularly. Shopify API changes require rapid updates. You will receive support tickets. True passive is a myth in this model — it is semi-passive at best, requiring 5-10 hours/month minimum maintenance.

**Capital to start:** $200-$500 (domain, dev environment, Shopify partner account $19). But real dev cost is $5,000-$25,000 if you need to hire. Solo technical founder = $200 start.

**P10/P50/P90 income estimates:**
- P10: <$100/month (never found distribution)
- P50: $725/month (Shopify median is $725/month)
- P90: $10,000-$50,000/month (top 25% Shopify = $167K/year)
- [SOURCE: mktclarity.com/shopify-app-worth-it]

**Base rate — who actually earns >$1K/month:**
Unknown precisely, but Shopify median $725/month implies >50% are below $1K. Winner-takes-most dynamic. Top 25% earn 80% of revenue.

**AI disruption risk: MEDIUM — AI upgrades plugins, not replaces them**
- Security, backup, payment, SEO plugins: AI augments but cannot replace [SOURCE: themewinter.com]
- AI is building plugin-like features natively into Shopify and WP.com — long-term pressure building

**Competition level 2025-2026:** 11,000+ Shopify apps, 40-90 new ones/week. WordPress repository has 60,000+ free plugins. Consolidation wave (Awesome Motive, WP Engine buying successful plugins) creating institutional competition.

**Lindy score:** WordPress plugin model = 20+ years. Shopify app ecosystem = 15 years. Structurally durable but market consolidating.

### MODEL 4: STOCK MUSIC / AUDIO LICENSING

**Precedents (verified):**

- PRO (ASCAP/BMI) performance royalties: each distributed $1B+ annually to rights holders [SOURCE: royaltyexchange.com]

**Sleep test (30 days zero work):**
YES — strongest sleep-test pass of all models. Tracks uploaded once earn indefinitely. A track from 2018 still earns in 2026. True passive after upload.

**Capital to start:** $0 (free upload on most platforms). Optional: DAW software ($0 using GarageBand/LMMS to $600 for Logic Pro).

**P10/P50/P90 income estimates (monthly, at 24 months):**
- P10: $10-$50/month (small catalog, generic genres)
- P50: $200-$800/month (100-300 tracks, multiple platforms)
- P90: $2,000-$5,000/month (500+ tracks, sync placements, PRO royalties)
- [SOURCE: orphiq.com, stockmusicmusician.com — calculated from stated ranges]

**Base rate — who actually earns >$1K/month:**
Estimated 5-10% of active stock music contributors. Volume is the key variable — under 100 tracks, $1K/month is nearly impossible.

**AI disruption risk: VERY HIGH for generic background music, MEDIUM for unique/branded compositions**
- Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs Music generate broadcast-ready tracks for $0.002-$0.02 per track
- Stock music platforms now accepting AI-generated audio (Pond5, some Audiojungle categories)
- Getty/Shutterstock merger signals creative revenue contraction across the board
- Generic corporate background music: essentially dead as a revenue category by 2026-2027

**Competition level 2025-2026:** Massive AI-generated supply flooding platforms. Pricing pressure acute. Survivable only in highly specific genres (live instrumentation, authentic regional music, sync-specific moods).

**Lindy score:** Music licensing = 100+ years. Stock music libraries = 30+ years. But AI is the most direct structural threat of any model here.

**Precedents (verified):**

- NOT passive — requires active buying, listing, negotiating

**Sleep test (30 days zero work):**
NO. Domains sit unsold. You must actively source, price, list, negotiate. Domain parking revenue (pay-per-click) is negligible — typically $0.01-$0.50/day per parked domain. This model is trading, not passive income.

**Capital to start:** $50-$500 for initial 5-50 domain portfolio

**P10/P50/P90 income estimates (monthly, consistent activity):**
- P10: -$50/month (renewal fees eating capital, nothing sold)
- P50: $300-$1,000/month (1-2 successful flips/month)
- P90: $3,000-$10,000/month (trend-surfing + volume)
- [SOURCE: earnfastest.com, sandyterrace.com]

**Base rate — who actually earns >$1K/month:**
Very low — estimated 5-10% of people who try domain flipping. Most lose money on renewals for domains that never sell. Selection of valuable domains requires significant pattern recognition that takes 1-2 years to develop.

**AI disruption risk: LOW-MEDIUM**
- AI doesn't eliminate need for memorable domain names
- AI may commoditize domain valuation tools (already underway with GoDaddy AI appraisals)
- New AI-specific domain categories (agentX.ai, etc.) creating opportunity

**Lindy score:** Domain registration/trading = 30+ years. Model structurally durable but this is trading, not passive income.

## RANKED RECOMMENDATIONS (by compound potential + base rate + sleep test)

**TIER 1 — Execute:**

**Micro-SaaS targeting one specific industry pain point** — only model with true compound structure (more customers = more data = better product = moat). Capital $200. Kill criteria: <5 paying users at month 3. Precedent: kitchen appliance scheduler at $6,700 MRR [SOURCE: softwareseni.com]. This fails the sleep test short-term but passes it at 24 months with low churn.

**TIER 2 — Conditional:**

**Niche operational templates (industry-specific, not generic)** — survivable against AI if deeply specific (e.g., "Vietnamese coffee export compliance tracker" not "productivity planner"). Condition: must have or build a targeted distribution channel before building. Kill criteria: <$200 revenue in first 60 days.

**Stock music catalog (live instrumentation, regional/ethnic genres)** — only model with true passive income from day one, but requires 12-24 months of catalog building before $1K/month. Condition: must have music production capability. AI threat is HIGH for generic categories, MEDIUM for authentic live instrumentation.

**TIER 3 — Kill or Avoid:**

**Stock photography** — KILL for new entrant. Market actively contracting. Getty/Shutterstock merger + AI displacement = no viable window.

**Domain flipping** — NOT passive income. Trading model. Fails sleep test. Only viable as speculative activity, not income architecture.

**Generic Canva/social media templates** — KILL. AI (Canva Magic Design, Gamma) generates these for free. Market collapsed for undifferentiated product.
